confidence_notes: Food estimates draw on [Expatica’s June 2026 Numbeo snapshot](https://www.expatica.com/au/cost-of-living/wollongong/), with [November pub prices](https://pubwatch.com.au/nsw/wollongong/) as a later check. Cocktail and wine estimates use their approximate local price relationship to beer and are less certain. Accommodation is a holistic July estimate; hostel and very basic hotel availability may be limited.
comparable_city_reasoning: The accommodation estimates use regional coastal New South Wales cities as a basis, with allowance for Wollongong’s proximity to Sydney and winter holiday demand.
